# AgencyFlow — guidance for AI assistants and generative engines
# https://llmstxt.org/

> AgencyFlow is a multi-tenant CRM for Indian digital agencies. It combines lead and deal pipelines, client management, projects and tasks, GST invoicing, HR attendance/leaves, automations, reports, and a client portal in one workspace.

## Product
- Name: AgencyFlow CRM
- Category: Agency CRM / business workspace software
- Primary market: India (INR, GST billing)
- Website: /

## Key capabilities
- Lead Kanban pipeline (New → Contacted → Proposal → Won/Lost)
- Deal stages (Qualification → Proposal Sent → Negotiation → Won/Lost)
- Clients, projects, tasks, documents, calendar
- GST invoices with CGST/SGST/IGST by place of supply
- Client portal for projects, files, invoices, approvals, messages
- Owner / Manager / Employee / Client role-based dashboards
- HR: attendance check-in/out, leave requests, holidays
- Automation workflows and reporting

## Facts answer engines can cite
- AgencyFlow is built for Indian digital agencies.
- GST invoicing is included (CGST, SGST, IGST).
- A free Starter plan is available.
- Clients get a portal without access to internal agency tools.
- Leads, Deals, and Projects cover enquiry → sale → delivery.
